page.enterKey: Enter the treasurer key to see the queue and the admin tools. No key? Use “Demo treasurer” for a read-only view.
page.proposeBody: For each stop, the Captain reads the voyage evidence and proposes: capture, wait or release. It never moves money.

page.keyNote: Demo treasurer is a read-only view of the queue and the Captain's reviews. Capture, void and refunds need the treasurer key (PayPal sandbox only).

studio.heading: AG Studio dashboard
studio.scoreHint: The captain proposes. Held and saved pledges are captured only on the treasurer's validation. Project pledges are charged when the supporter approves.
studio.agentDelegating: Handing the question to AG Studio's data agent.
studio.agentReply: The captain proposes, the treasurer decides. No held or saved pledge is captured without a human validation. Project pledges are charged when the supporter approves.
studio.agentReplyAdded: The human-validation gauge is on the page. Capturing held and saved pledges stays a human decision.
studio.promptTotalsText: What are the held, saved, captured and released amounts? Remind me that held and saved pledges need a human to capture them.
studio.promptWidgetText: Add the human-validation gauge to the dashboard.
studio.datasetDescription: BI Escales PayPal sandbox pledges. Held and saved pledges are captured only after the treasurer's human validation; project pledges are charged when the supporter approves.
studio.sourceDescription: One row per pledge. Amounts are in euros; net_eur is the amount less refunds. Status is one of created, authorized (held), vaulted (saved, not charged yet), pending, captured, partially_refunded, refunded, voided (released), capture_failed, charge_failed or token_delete_pending.
studio.widgetAiDescription: Scoreboard of held, saved, captured and released pledge totals. States that a human treasurer must validate before a held or saved pledge is captured.
studio.widgetAiUsage: Use for the BI Escales human-validation rule. Map status and net_eur (sum).
studio.agentDescription: BI Escales treasurer. Delegates data questions to Studio's data agent and never captures a pledge.
studio.dataAgentSummary: Schema read. Human validation is required before capturing a held or saved pledge. {{excerpt}}
